name: Jet Strike : VR Fighter Jet Warfare
summary:
Step aboard a powerful battleship and prepare for intense aerial combat in Jet Strike: VR Fighter Jet Warfare — an immersive VR shooting experience where you control the deck gun and defend your ship from waves of enemy aircraft.

Engage in thrilling dogfights as fighter jets soar overhead, performing deadly dives and bombing runs. Your mission: aim, track, and destroy them before they take down your ship.
